Variants.Content: The ironborn use "salt and rock" to distinguish between the plundering of the sea and the cultivation of green fields. It is both a language of pride and a language that masks the island’s dependence on trade, fishing and imported food; the stories a nation tells itself are often more powerful than its ledgers.

Entry Salt and Rock of the Ironborn The ironborn use "salt and rock" to distinguish between the plundering of the sea and the cultivation of green fields. It is both a language of pride and a language that masks the island’s dependence on trade, fishing and imported food; the stories a nation tells itself are often more powerful than its ledgers.
